notablePrerequisites: At least three reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Pollenbright Druid.
Magnanimous Magistrate triggers, causing you to remove two counters from it and return Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Pollenbright Druid enters the battlefield, proliferate, putting two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing any player to mill a card.
Repeat.
